note: Listening passages (Path stops of kind l). Each is a short dialogue: lines spoken by 女 (the woman's voice) or 男 (the man's voice), then questions in Chinese with four options (the first option in the file is the right one; the site shuffles them). line = the index of the line that holds the answer (it is played again after the question is answered). Words: only words of this level and the levels below. The Path places each passage right after the stop that teaches the last of its words (tools/build-path.py). Built by tools/build-passages.py into data/passages.js; AI-written, checked by tools/check-content.py, not yet reviewed by a person.

passages.title: A family photo
passages.scene: Xiaoming shows a friend his family.

lines.en: Xiaoming, is this your family?

lines.zh: 是。这是我爸爸，这是我妈妈。
lines.en: Yes. This is my dad, and this is my mum.
Who is this child?
She is my younger sister. She is eight.
Your younger sister is really pretty!

qs.en: Who is the child?
How old is the child?
What is the child like?

passages.title: Tomorrow morning
passages.scene: Two friends plan a trip to the bookshop.

lines.en: What time do you get up tomorrow?
I get up at six. And you?

lines.zh: 我七点。明天上午我们去书店，好吗？
lines.en: I get up at seven. Shall we go to the bookshop tomorrow morning?
OK! Let's meet at nine.

qs.en: What time does the woman get up?
Where are they going tomorrow?
What time will they meet?

passages.title: Buying apples
passages.scene: A woman buys fruit at a small shop.

lines.en: Hello, excuse me, how much are the apples?
Three yuan each.

lines.zh: 很贵。有便宜一点儿的吗？
lines.en: That is expensive. Do you have cheaper ones?
Yes, these are two yuan each.
OK, I will buy five.
Sure, that is ten yuan.

qs.en: What does the woman buy?
How many does the woman buy?
How much are five apples?

passages.title: Too expensive
passages.scene: A woman looks at clothes in a shop.

lines.zh: 这件衣服真漂亮！多少钱？
lines.en: This piece of clothing is really pretty! How much is it?
It is 300 yuan.
That is expensive. What about that one?
That one is cheap: 100 yuan.
OK, I will buy that one.

qs.en: How much is this piece of clothing?
What is this piece of clothing like?
Which one does the woman buy?

passages.title: At the restaurant
passages.scene: A waiter takes an order from two friends.

lines.en: Hello, what would you like to eat?
I would like rice and eggs.
What are you drinking?

lines.zh: 我喝茶。我的朋友要一杯牛奶。
lines.en: I will have tea. My friend wants a glass of milk.
Sure.

qs.en: What does the woman want to eat?
What does the woman drink?
What does the woman's friend want?

passages.title: Dad's job
passages.scene: Two classmates talk about their parents.

lines.en: Where does your dad work?

lines.zh: 他在医院工作，他是医生。
lines.en: He works at a hospital. He is a doctor.
Is he busy?

lines.zh: 非常忙，他晚上九点下班。
lines.en: Very busy. He finishes work at nine in the evening.

qs.en: Where does the woman's dad work?
Is the woman's dad busy?
What time does the woman's dad finish work?

passages.title: Cold today, rain tomorrow
passages.scene: Two friends talk about the weather.

lines.en: What is the weather like today?
Very cold. Tomorrow it will rain.
Will it be cold tomorrow?
Tomorrow it will not be cold; it will be hot.

qs.en: What is the weather like today?
What will the weather be like tomorrow?
Will it be cold tomorrow?

passages.title: Rest for two days
passages.scene: A friend asks a woman how she is.

lines.en: What is wrong with you?
I am ill.
Did you go to the hospital to see a doctor?

lines.zh: 去了。医生说我要休息两天。
lines.en: I went. The doctor said I need to rest for two days.
Then you should go home and rest well.

qs.en: What is wrong with the woman?
Where did the woman go?
What does the doctor say the woman needs to do?

passages.title: Where are you?
passages.scene: A man calls a woman who is out shopping.

lines.en: Hello, where are you?
I am at the supermarket buying things.
When are you coming home?

lines.zh: 我四点回家。你想吃什么？
lines.en: I will be home at four. What would you like to eat?
I would like some bread.

qs.en: Where is the woman?
What time is the woman going home?
What does the man want to eat?

passages.title: A film on Sunday
passages.scene: Two friends make plans for Sunday.

lines.en: Where do you want to go on Sunday?
I want to go to the cinema. Are you going?
Yes! What time shall we go?

lines.zh: 下午三点。我们坐出租车去。
lines.en: At three in the afternoon. We will take a taxi.
OK, see you on Sunday.

qs.en: Where does the man want to go on Sunday?
What time are they going?
How are they getting there?

passages.title: Two dogs
passages.scene: A woman asks a man about his pets.

lines.en: Do you have a cat at home?
No cat. My family has two dogs.
One is big and one is small.

lines.zh: 我很喜欢狗，我可以去看看吗？
lines.en: I really like dogs. Can I go and see them?
Sure, you can come to my home tomorrow.

qs.en: What does the man have at home?
What does the woman like?

qs.zh: 女的什么时候去男的家？
qs.en: When will the woman go to the man's home?

passages.title: A hundred characters
passages.scene: A man asks a woman about her Chinese class.

lines.en: Are you studying Chinese?
Yes, I study Chinese at university.
Do you like writing Chinese characters?

lines.zh: 喜欢。我今天写了一百个汉字。
lines.en: I do. Today I wrote one hundred characters.
That is great!

qs.en: Where does the woman study Chinese?
Does the woman like writing Chinese characters?

qs.zh: 女的今天写了多少个汉字？
qs.en: How many characters did the woman write today?

passages.title: Grandpa runs every morning
passages.scene: A woman asks Xiaoming about his family.

lines.en: Xiaoming, how many people are there in your family?

lines.zh: 五口人：爷爷、奶奶、爸爸、妈妈和我。
lines.en: Five: my grandpa, my grandma, my dad, my mum and me.
How old are your grandpa and grandma now?

lines.zh: 爷爷七十岁，奶奶六十八岁。
lines.en: My grandpa is seventy and my grandma is sixty-eight.
Are they in good health?

lines.zh: 很好！爷爷每天早上都去跑步。
lines.en: Very good! My grandpa goes running every morning.

qs.en: How many people are there in Xiaoming's family?
How old is Xiaoming's grandma?
Who goes running every morning?

qs.zh: 小明的爷爷奶奶身体怎么样？
qs.en: How is the health of Xiaoming's grandparents?

passages.title: The way to the metro
passages.scene: A man asks a woman for directions.

lines.en: Excuse me, where is the metro station?
Go straight ahead, then go left.
Is it far?

lines.zh: 不远，走路五分钟就到了。
lines.en: Not far. You will be there in just five minutes on foot.

lines.zh: 地铁站旁边有一个大商场，很好找。
lines.en: There is a big shopping centre next to the metro station, so it is easy to find.
Thank you!

qs.en: Where does the man want to go?
How do you get to the metro station?
How many minutes do you need on foot?
What is next to the metro station?

passages.title: A present for Mum
passages.scene: A woman looks for a birthday present in a shop.

lines.zh: 下个星期六是我妈妈的生日，我想送她一件衣服。
lines.en: Next Saturday is my mum's birthday, and I want to give her a piece of clothing.
What colour does your mum like?
She likes red and white.
How about this white one?

lines.zh: 太长了。有没有小一点儿的？
lines.en: It is too long. Do you have a slightly smaller one?

lines.zh: 有，这件小一点儿，也是白色的。
lines.en: Yes, this one is a little smaller, and it is white too.
Good, I will take this one.

qs.zh: 下个星期六是谁的生日？
qs.en: Whose birthday is next Saturday?
What does the woman want to give?

qs.zh: 女的妈妈喜欢什么颜色？
qs.en: What colours does the woman's mum like?
What is the first piece of clothing like?

passages.title: Too long at the computer
passages.scene: A man sees a doctor.

lines.zh: 医生，我头疼，眼睛也有点儿疼。
lines.en: Doctor, I have a headache, and my eyes hurt a little too.
When did your head start to hurt?

lines.zh: 昨天晚上。我昨天在电脑前面工作了十个小时。
lines.en: Yesterday evening. Yesterday I worked in front of the computer for ten hours.

lines.zh: 你太累了。回家多休息，别看手机，也别看电脑了。
lines.en: You are too tired. Rest more at home, and stop looking at your phone and your computer.
OK, thank you, doctor.

qs.en: Where does the man not feel well?

qs.zh: 男的什么时候开始疼的？
qs.en: When did the man start to hurt?

qs.zh: 男的昨天工作了几个小时？
qs.en: How many hours did the man work yesterday?
What does the doctor tell the man not to do?

passages.title: Basketball or swimming
passages.scene: Two friends talk about what they do on Saturdays and Sundays.

lines.zh: 星期六和星期天你经常做什么？
lines.en: What do you often do on Saturdays and Sundays?
I often go and play basketball. And you?

lines.zh: 我不太喜欢篮球，我喜欢游泳。
lines.en: I do not really like basketball; I like swimming.

lines.zh: 我小时候学过游泳，但是现在游得不好。
lines.en: I learned to swim when I was little, but now I do not swim well.

lines.zh: 那这个星期天我们一起去游泳吧！
lines.en: Then let's go swimming together this Sunday!
Sure, what time?

lines.zh: 我们上午十点在学校门口见。
lines.en: We will meet at the school gate at ten in the morning.

qs.zh: 男的星期六和星期天经常做什么？
qs.en: What does the man often do on Saturdays and Sundays?
What sport does the woman like?
How does the man swim now?
Where will they meet?

passages.title: To the airport
passages.scene: A woman takes a taxi.

lines.en: Hello, I am going to the airport.
Sure. What time is your flight?

lines.zh: 十二点的。现在已经十点了，我们什么时候能到？
lines.en: Twelve o'clock. It is already ten now; when can we get there?

lines.zh: 要一个小时。路上车不多，不会晚的。
lines.en: It takes an hour. There are not many cars on the road, so you will not be late.
Great, thank you.

qs.en: Where does the woman want to go?
What time is the woman's flight?
How long does it take to get to the airport?
What does the man say about the road?

passages.title: A room on the fifth floor
passages.scene: A man checks in at a hotel.

lines.zh: 你好，我想住两天，还有房间吗？
lines.en: Hello, I would like to stay for two days. Do you have any rooms left?

lines.zh: 有。您要一个人的房间吗？
lines.en: Yes. Would you like a room for one person?

lines.zh: 对，一个人的。一天多少钱？
lines.en: Yes, for one person. How much is it a day?
It is 400 yuan a day, with breakfast.
Can guests go online in the room?
Yes, they can. Your room is on the fifth floor.

qs.en: How many days does the man want to stay?
A room for how many people does the man want?
How much is the room a day?
Which floor is the man's room on?

passages.title: The exam tomorrow
passages.scene: Two classmates talk the day before an exam.

lines.zh: 你准备好明天的考试了吗？
lines.en: Are you ready for tomorrow's exam?

lines.zh: 还没有。我还有很多题不懂。
lines.en: Not yet. There are still many questions I do not understand.

lines.zh: 哪些题不懂？我可以帮你。
lines.en: Which questions do you not understand? I can help you.

lines.zh: 太好了！第三题和第五题我都不会。
lines.en: Great! I cannot do question three or question five.

lines.zh: 没问题，今天晚上我们在教室见，我教你。
lines.en: No problem. Let's meet in the classroom this evening, and I will teach you.
Thank you!

qs.en: What do they have tomorrow?
Has the man finished preparing?
Which two questions can the man not do?

qs.zh: 他们今天晚上在哪儿见？
qs.en: Where will they meet this evening?

passages.title: Still on the bus
passages.scene: A man calls a friend who is late for a film.

lines.zh: 喂，你到哪儿了？电影快要开始了。
lines.en: Hello, where are you? The film is about to start.

lines.zh: 对不起，我还在路上。路上车太多了。
lines.en: Sorry, I am still on the way. There are too many cars on the road.
Are you on the bus?
Yes. I will be there in ten minutes.

lines.zh: 别跑，慢慢走。我在电影院门口等你。
lines.en: Do not run; walk slowly. I am waiting for you at the cinema entrance.

qs.en: What are they going to do?
What does the woman say about the road?
How is the woman getting there?
Where is the man waiting for her?

passages.title: Which phone?
passages.scene: A woman chooses a new phone.

lines.en: Of these two phones, which one is good?

lines.zh: 这个比那个贵五百块，也比那个快。
lines.en: This one costs 500 yuan more than that one, and it is faster than that one too.
I only make calls and go online.

lines.zh: 那你买便宜的吧，那个也不错。
lines.en: Then you should buy the cheap one. That one is good too.
OK, I will buy that one.

qs.en: Which phone is more expensive?

qs.zh: 贵的手机比便宜的贵多少钱？
qs.en: How much more does the expensive phone cost than the cheap one?
What does the woman say she only does?
Which one does the woman buy?

passages.title: A missed class
passages.scene: A classmate calls a woman who missed class.

lines.zh: 你今天为什么没来上课？
lines.en: Why did you not come to class today?

lines.zh: 因为我生病了，所以在家休息。
lines.en: Because I was ill, so I rested at home.
Are you a bit better now?

lines.zh: 好多了。今天上课老师说了什么？
lines.en: Much better. What did the teacher say in class today?

lines.zh: 老师说下个星期一考试，你要好好准备。
lines.en: The teacher said there is an exam next Monday, so you need to prepare well.
OK, thank you for telling me.

qs.zh: 女的今天为什么没来上课？
qs.en: Why did the woman not come to class today?
How is the woman now?
When is the exam?
Why does the woman thank the man?

passages.title: Coffee or milk tea
passages.scene: Two friends order drinks in a café.

lines.en: Would you like coffee or milk tea?

lines.zh: 我晚上不喝咖啡，喝了睡不着。
lines.en: I do not drink coffee in the evening: if I drink it, I cannot fall asleep.

lines.zh: 那我们要一杯奶茶和一杯咖啡吧。
lines.en: Then let's get a milk tea and a coffee.
OK. What else would you like to eat?

lines.zh: 我要一个面包，我早上没吃饭。
lines.en: I want a bread roll. I did not eat this morning.

qs.en: Why does the woman not drink coffee?
What does the woman drink?
What else does the man want?
Did the man eat this morning?
